Opposition Parties Write to Chief Justice on Electoral Roll Process

Twenty-three opposition parties, including the DMK and AAP, have jointly written to the Chief Justice of India regarding the ongoing Special Summary Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The parties allege a lack of transparency and potential misuse in the process, urging judicial intervention. The letter signifies a united front on this issue, with even parties previously seen as distant now participating.
